recentItems.title: Putin Agrees To Resume US-Ukraine-Russia Peace Talks In November After Witkoff Meeting | Watch
recentItems.description:
Russian President Vladimir Putin has reportedly agreed to resume trilateral peace talks with the United States and Ukraine as early as November, following a meeting with US envoy Steve Witkoff in St. Petersburg. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has expressed support for the US proposal, calling for negotiations to begin soon.

The diplomatic push comes as Russian and Ukrainian attacks continue, with strikes reported in Kyiv and Russia’s Lipetsk region. The release of American teacher Stephen Hubbard from Russian detention has also drawn attention, while Witkoff’s praise of Putin has sparked criticism from US lawmakers. Key issues remain unresolved, including ceasefire terms, security guarantees and Washington’s future support for Kyiv.

recentItems.title: Flying Cars In UAE: Chinese Aircraft Unveiled As Ras Al Khaimah Plans Trials | WATCH
recentItems.description:
Flying cars could soon take to the skies over the UAE, with Ras Al Khaimah ruler Sheikh Saud bin Saqr Al Qasimi unveiling a Chinese-made aircraft destined for testing in the emirate during a visit to manufacturer Aridge's factory in Guangzhou on Tuesday.

Footage shows Sheikh Saud touring the production line alongside Aridge founder Zhao Deli, inspecting the futuristic vehicles before unveiling the first X3-F aircraft designated for the UAE's advanced air mobility testing programme. Workers can be seen assembling the machines, while archive footage shows the aircraft taking off and flying during earlier trials. Dubbed the 'Land Aircraft Carrier', the vehicle combines a six-wheeled carrier with a detachable electric aircraft, allowing passengers to drive to a take-off point before flying.

recentItems.title: Australia Floods: Driver Rescued From Sinking Car In Dramatic Floodwater Operation | WATCH
recentItems.description:
An Australian television reporter and another bystander rescued a driver from a sinking car trapped in floodwaters in Morayfield on Thursday. ABC reporter Will Murray and the man swam towards the vehicle, initially attempting to break its rear windscreen before opening a door to pull the driver to safety. No injuries were reported. Authorities have issued flood warnings in the area following heavy rainfall.

recentItems.title: ‘They Are Nuts!’ Trump Claims Iran Would Use Nuclear Weapon Within One Hour, Says Wars Will End
recentItems.description:
US President Donald Trump warned that Iran could use a nuclear weapon within an hour if it acquired one, describing Tehran as “nuts” during a rally in South Carolina on Wednesday. Trump claimed his administration had settled eight conflicts and said efforts to end the Russia-Ukraine war and the conflict involving Iran were ongoing. His remarks come amid stalled US-Iran negotiations and disagreements over reopening the Strait of Hormuz, ahead of the US midterm elections on November 3.

recentItems.title: Iran Snubs Munir! Pakistan's Army Chief Gets Humiliated By Rezaei After Trump's Shock Ultimatum
recentItems.description:
Pakistan Army Chief Asim Munir’s visit to Tehran has sparked controversy amid reports of a tense reception from Iran’s security chief, Mohsen Rezaei. Munir reportedly carried a message from US President Donald Trump demanding major concessions on Iran’s nuclear programme. Tehran, however, has stood firm, insisting that Washington must address its conditions. Reports of a cold exchange and Iran’s refusal to surrender enriched nuclear material have raised questions about Pakistan’s mediation efforts as tensions between the US and Iran continue.
